tagline.en: HPC-AI Tech's open text-to-video model — Apache-2.0 weights built on the STDiT diffusion transformer and a dedicated video VAE.
tagline.zh: HPC-AI Tech 开源的文生视频模型——Apache-2.0 权重,基于 STDiT 扩散 transformer 与专用视频 VAE。

en: Open-Sora is HPC-AI Tech's open effort to make high-quality text-to-video generation accessible. You give it a text prompt and it produces a short video clip, with weights released under Apache-2.0.

The pipeline pairs an STDiT diffusion transformer (the STDiT-v3 checkpoint) with a dedicated video VAE (OpenSora-VAE-v1.2) that compresses and reconstructs video latents; an earlier high-quality STDiT-v1 checkpoint is also available. Because model and VAE live in separate repositories, both are staged for a run.
In WorldFoundry, Open-Sora runs through the shared pipeline — supply a prompt, and it renders a video.
zh: Open-Sora 是 HPC-AI Tech 让高质量文生视频更易获得的开源项目。你给它一段文字提示词,它生成一段短视频片段,权重以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。
该流程将 STDiT 扩散 transformer(STDiT-v3 checkpoint)与专用视频 VAE(OpenSora-VAE-v1.2)配对,后者负责压缩与重建视频 latent;此外还提供一个更早的高质量 STDiT-v1 checkpoint。由于模型与 VAE 分属不同仓库,运行时需同时准备两者。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Open-Sora 通过统一 pipeline 运行——给出提示词,它就渲染出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: Use Open-Sora when you want an openly-licensed text-to-video model to prototype prompt-driven clip generation on your own hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个开放许可的文生视频模型、在自有硬件上做提示词驱动的片段生成原型时,可以使用 Open-Sora。

notFor.en: Generation needs both the STDiT model and its matching VAE, downloaded separately — plan for the extra download and disk space before a run.
notFor.zh: 生成需要 STDiT 模型与其配套 VAE,两者需分别下载——运行前请预留额外的下载与磁盘空间。
